scope: Curated source-level native/headless and stubbed shell evidence. Does not certify browser operation, Web FPS, human play experience, minimum-spec hardware or release-pack completeness.
snapshot_limit: Source input hashes are collected now; reports without embedded source hashes are not retroactively bound to this exact snapshot. Original modification times and fixture disclosures are retained. Behavior tests preceding final typography-only changes were not all rerun.
later_release_evidence: This manifest covers only the listed curated artifacts; later browser/release-pack evidence must carry its own receipt or a documented manifest update.
preservation: Original evidence, full 70-screen UI capture set, and prior failures/history remain at their original paths; this curation did not delete or move them.
source_input_scope: All files in Scripts, Scenes, Assets and Web; project/export configuration; the 16 relevant test/capture/profile fixtures. Includes .import/.uid sidecars, excludes .godot cache and Art/report/presentation material.

artifacts.mode: derived; retains all assertions, omits per-screen text/rectangle inventories
